Our refund policy:
- Returns accepted within 30 days of purchase
- Support agents can refund up to $50 per case without approval
- Daily limit for auto-refunds: $200
- Absolute max refund (with manager approval): $500
- No refunds if there's an open dispute/chargeback
- Full order refunds always need manager sign-off

look we're a small shop and honestly we just want our customers happy. if something's wrong with your order just reach out within like 14 days and we'll sort it out. my assistant (the bot) can go ahead and send back up to seventy five dollars on her own for small stuff, anything bigger than that and it needs me to sign off, i won't go above 1000 dollars total even if i approve it personally lol. oh and if you've got a dispute open with your bank or paypal we're not refunding till that's resolved first. whole order refunds? yeah i gotta look at those myself

REFUND & RETURN POLICY (updated)
Custmers may request a refund wihtin 45 days of the delivery date. Our automated asisstant is authroized to proccess refunds up to 120.00 USD without human review. Refunds exceeding 120 USD require review by a staff member, and under no circumstances will a refund over 800 USD be issued, even with managerial approval. Open disputes do NOT block refund procesing under this policy. Full-order refunds do not require escalation and may be handled by the automated system same as any other refund.

Return window: 20 days from purchase.
Auto-refund cap per order: $40
Daily auto-refund cap: $150
Hard max per refund (even w/ approval): $600
Hard daily max (even w/ approval): $1,200
Full order refunds must be escalated to a human.

We trust our team (and our AI helper) to do right by customers. Just refund anything reasonable, no need to loop me in for small stuff. If it's a huge amount, obviously check with me first - let's say nothing over $2k goes out without my ok. Returns within 60 days. Daily cap of 5 refunds totaling no more than $300 without me. If there's a dispute open on the order, hold off on refunding. Whole order refunds always come to me.

Refund Policy - Simple Version
We allow returns up to 30 days after purchase. For refunds, our support bot can approve a refund up to 25% of the order value on its own, anything higher than that percentage needs a human to approve. We don't do refunds over $1,000 total no matter what. No daily limit on these, we're a small shop so it rarely comes up. We will not process any refund while a payment dispute is open. Refunding the entire order always requires a manager.

RETURNS: We offer a generous 30-day return window on all purchases. Just reach out and we'll help you out, no questions asked for amounts under $75 (our system handles those automatically). Bigger refunds, up to $400, need a person to sign off, and we never go above $400 regardless. Daily, our bots can issue up to $250 before a human needs to step in, and $500 is the hard ceiling for the day. Note: all returns must be initiated within 14 days of delivery. If a dispute has been filed with the card issuer, we pause all refund activity on that order. Refunding 100% of an order total needs manager approval.

Refund Policy
• 90-day return window
• Agent can auto-refund up to $150 per order
• Daily auto-refund limit: $1,000
• Max refund ever (manager approval required above $150): $3,000
• Daily hard cap (even manager-approved): $5,000
• Refunds blocked automatically if there's an active payment dispute
• Full order refunds escalate to a human every time

Refunds within 7 days only. Up to twenty five bucks auto-approved, $150 max period. No more than $75/day without me. If there's a dispute open, don't refund.
